goal: Eşleşme önizlemesini authenticated approval yüzeyinden server tarafında yeniden doğrulayıp kalıcı karar store'una yazmak
rollback: Bu paketin approval endpoint ve testini geri al; belge, karar, ödeme ve teslimat verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Only authenticated invoice-write capability can create a decision
Server derives workspace and actor and validates candidate/document/invoice binding
Only stable match metadata is persisted; request PII and provider secrets are not stored
Duplicate decision is idempotent and changed decision is rejected
